messages:
Alex K: Quick heads-up — we need a final pass on quickstarts + sampleapps before the changelog cutoff. Target EOD Fri. Who's owning sampleapp QA and the changelog entry? @Priya S @Drew L
Priya S: I can own the changelog entry. Will draft tomorrow AM and drop it in #docs-drafts.
Drew L: I can take sampleapp QA, but CI shows one failing test on the docker build. cc @Maria T
Drew L: Failing output: ```
ERROR: missing env var QUICKSTART_API_KEY
```
Maria T: Ack — I added that env var in #421 but forgot to update the sampleapp startup check. I'll push a small fix + note to docs.
Samir R: FYI release branch freeze is scheduled 18:00 PT Fri per release-bot. Who needs final review approvals? @Alex K
Alex K: Need 2 approvals for the sampleapp PR and 1 approval for the docs PR. Drew, please ping @bench and @ty for CRs.
Drew L: Pinged @bench, @ty — also will open a tiny PR to add a smoke test (so we don't regress the build).
release-bot: Changelog cutoff scheduled for Fri 18:00 PT. After cutoff only critical fixes allowed.
Priya S: I'll drop the changelog draft in #docs-drafts by Thu EOD for review; please add short bullets, one-liners only.
Alex K: If the sampleapp fix is tiny we can merge behind a canary flag; otherwise we include a fallback note in the changelog. :thumbsup:
Maria T: Pushed fix (PR opened) — added an env-check and better error message. Smoke test command added to README: ```
make smoke
```
Drew L: Running smoke now. If green I'll request +2 from bench/ty. Samir, can you approve the docs PR once Priya uploads?
Samir R: Will approve docs once CI passes. @Alex K, please add the changelog line when Priya posts the draft.
Priya S: Draft uploaded: https://redwood.docs/drafts/quickstart-changelog-2876 — please comment on phrasing.
Alex K: Thanks all — I'll do final merge-window checks Fri 16:30 PT. Call out anything that will block merge earlier so we can triage.
